name: US Territories and Freely Associated States
description: Puerto Rico urbanizations and Spanish-order streets, Guam, the US Virgin Islands, American Samoa, the Northern Mariana Islands and the freely associated states that use US ZIP codes. Urbanization cases are partial: they check the URB line goes to locality and the rest parses. Shapes follow USPS Publication 28 (a US government work, public domain); inputs are constructed for this corpus unless a case's source says otherwise.
